serviciosPage.title: Services
serviciosPage.description: Comprehensive residential maintenance services. We offer technical solutions in repairs, installations, and preventive maintenance of homes. Our goal is to extend the useful life of your installations and improve comfort in your home with efficient and reliable service.

servicios.descripcion: Asphalt roofs are the most common and cost-effective option to protect your home against rain, hail, and intense sun. With fiberglass or wood composites, asphalt shingles offer excellent waterproofing and a lifespan of 20 to 30 years. Their quick and easy installation minimizes disruptions, while the variety of colors and styles enhances the aesthetics of any home. Additionally, they are easy to repair and recycle, reducing long-term cost and environmental impact.

Metal roofs combine strength and longevity, lasting up to 50 years under extreme conditions. Made from steel, aluminum, or copper, they repel heat and withstand strong winds, heavy snow, and hail without cracking. Their light and thin profile reduces structural load, ideal for renovations over existing roofs. They are available in matte, glossy finishes, or with special coatings, giving a modern and minimalist look.

Siding is an exterior layer that protects and decorates facades, improving thermal insulation and energy efficiency. Available in vinyl, fiber cement, treated wood, or composite panels, it provides resistance to moisture, insects, and sun fading. Its maintenance is minimal: just periodic washing to preserve color and material integrity. Additionally, it allows customization of the home's style with a wide palette of textures and tones.

We offer cleaning, inspection, and repair of chimneys to ensure safe and efficient draft. We address cracks in masonry, joint repointing, installation of protective crowns, and replacement of interior linings. Our service includes certification of compliance with local codes and recommendations to prevent soot fires or water leaks. With regular maintenance, we extend the lifespan of your chimney and improve indoor air quality.

We specialize in the construction and restoration of concrete surfaces such as patios, driveways, sidewalks, and terraces. We use high-resistance mixes that withstand temperature changes, oils, and vehicle weight. We offer smooth, stamped, and polished finishes, adapting to your home's style and adding aesthetic and functional value. Additionally, we apply waterproofing sealers to reduce cracks and stains over time.

Framing or wood framing is the foundation of any safe and durable construction. We install beams, studs, and structural panels with selected woods and moisture-resistant and fire-retardant treatments. Our process ensures uniform load distribution, moderate seismic resistance, and ease of incorporating electrical and plumbing installations. Ideal for expansions, internal renovations, or supporting new levels in your home.

We design and install interior and exterior stairs that combine ergonomics, aesthetics, and regulatory compliance. We work with solid wood, metal, or reinforced concrete, offering safe railings and non-slip steps. Each project adapts to the available space, optimizing light and circulation flow. Our approach integrates quality finishes and personalized details, from curved handrails to integrated step lighting.

items.descripcion: For this roofing project, we installed premium asphalt shingles with a fiberglass core and mineral coating, designed to resist impacts and UV rays. The roof was prepared with OSB sheathing and a synthetic waterproof barrier to ensure watertightness. The shingles were laid with precise overlaps and specialized fasteners for efficient drainage. Ventilated gutters and metal flashings protect critical areas, creating an even, durable roof that requires little maintenance.

For this siding project, we installed a ventilated facade with horizontal treated-wood slats, aligned for a contemporary finish and warm texture. Each slat was selected for its weather resistance and natural grain and secured with concealed stainless steel anchors for clean lines. We added a garage door with frosted glass panels framed in black metal, creating an elegant contrast and enhancing diffused light. Above it, a wall light with a black base and opal diffuser highlights the wood at night. Palm trees and ornamental plants add freshness and connect the project with its surroundings. The result is a modern, harmonious facade that enhances the home.

For this project, we designed and built reinforced concrete exterior stairs and a curved walkway connecting the main entrance to the street. The stairs have 17 cm risers and 30 cm treads, a brushed non-slip finish, and natural stone edges for durability, using custom formwork and H-25 concrete poured on site.

The 1.2 m wide walkway was built with light-gray polished concrete and perimeter expansion joints to support drainage and prevent cracks.

We added recessed step lighting and planters with grass and ornamental shrubs, creating a safe, attractive entrance that complements the home’s contemporary architecture.

items.descripcionPuesto: Responsible for planning and supervising infrastructure projects such as houses, buildings, and roads. A university degree in Civil Engineering and at least 3 years of field experience are required. Proficiency in AutoCAD and Civil 3D. Fluent English is mandatory; Spanish is desirable.
Direct supervision of construction crews on site. At least 5 years of experience leading building or road projects. Knowledge of OSHA regulations. Bilingual English/Spanish candidates are preferred.
Land measurement and surveying for future developments. Knowledge of total stations, GPS, and CAD software is required. Surveying technician or engineer. English is required; German is an advantage.
Design architectural plans and verify compliance with local regulations. At least 2 years of experience. Advanced AutoCAD, Revit, and SketchUp skills. Fluent English; German or Spanish is optional.
Operate excavators, front-end loaders, and backhoes. A valid license and 2 years of experience are required. Basic English and fluent Spanish are required for site safety.
General site support: mixing cement, loading materials, and cleaning work areas. Previous experience is valued but not required. Training is provided. Spanish is required; basic English.
Electrical installation in buildings under construction. A valid certification and 3 years of site experience are required. English is mandatory; Spanish is desirable.
Build walls and concrete structures and carry out finish work. At least 4 years of proven experience. Fluent Spanish is required; English is optional.
Install piping and drainage systems and review plumbing plans. Certified technician with at least 2 years of experience. English and Spanish are required.
Coordinate construction teams, schedules, and materials. At least 5 years of experience as a site manager. Fluent English is required, along with communication skills in Spanish.

Calculate and design structures for residential and commercial buildings. A degree in Structural or Civil Engineering is required. Advanced English and technical German are recommended for international collaboration.
Assist with basic site tasks such as loading, cleaning, and supporting specialized staff. No experience is required. Spanish is essential; basic English is useful.
Carry out structural demolition following safety protocols. Knowledge of machinery and the use of controlled explosives. Spanish and English are required.
Plan and supervise road and urban construction. Experience with DOT projects. A high level of technical English is required. Basic German is a plus.
Responsible for concrete mixing, pouring, and curing. Certification in concrete techniques is preferred. Fluent Spanish is required; English is desirable.

generalServicios.descripcion: Comprehensive residential maintenance services offer technical solutions for repairs, installations, and preventative maintenance of homes. Our goal is to extend the lifespan of your property and improve comfort in your home with efficient and reliable service.

preguntasFrecuentes.pregunta: What type of services does Ace Home Improvement Services offer?
preguntasFrecuentes.respuesta: We offer comprehensive residential maintenance, including remodeling, repairs, installations, painting, plumbing, electrical work, and more.

preguntasFrecuentes.pregunta: Does Ace handle obtaining the necessary permits for the work?
preguntasFrecuentes.respuesta: Yes. We manage the entire process of municipal and legal permits required for each type of project.

preguntasFrecuentes.pregunta: Do you hire workers directly or subcontract?
preguntasFrecuentes.respuesta: We have qualified staff and also collaborate with certified providers and contractors depending on the needs of the project.

preguntasFrecuentes.pregunta: Can I request a free quote?
preguntasFrecuentes.respuesta: Yes. You can request a no-obligation quote through the form on our website or by calling our contact number directly.

preguntasFrecuentes.pregunta: In which areas or regions do you offer your services?
preguntasFrecuentes.respuesta: We currently operate in the United States, but you can contact us to confirm availability in your area.

preguntasFrecuentes.pregunta: How are materials managed for projects?
preguntasFrecuentes.respuesta: We handle all material logistics: selection, purchasing, and delivery to the project site, always prioritizing quality and efficiency.

preguntasFrecuentes.pregunta: Do you offer a warranty on your work?
preguntasFrecuentes.respuesta: Yes. All our services include a warranty, whose duration depends on the type of work performed. Details are included in each contract.

preguntasFrecuentes.pregunta: How can I track the progress of my project?
preguntasFrecuentes.respuesta: We assign a supervisor who stays in contact with you throughout the process and provides regular updates.

preguntasFrecuentes.pregunta: Do you accept online payments or credit cards?
preguntasFrecuentes.respuesta: Yes. We offer multiple payment methods, including bank transfers, credit cards, and online payments through our website.

preguntasFrecuentes.pregunta: How long does a typical project take to complete?
preguntasFrecuentes.respuesta: It depends on the type and scope of the work. A minor repair may take hours, while full remodels may take several weeks. We provide a detailed timeline at the start of the project.

galeria.descripcion: Our gallery features real examples of our roofing, siding, and exterior finishing work. Each project reflects our quality and precision, from installing durable shingles to long-lasting siding that enhances facades. We also offer walkways and exterior stairs as individual services, connecting your home safely and harmoniously with its surroundings. Explore our solutions and discover how we can transform every detail into a functional, attractive space.
galeria.irA: Click a button to go to:
Galeria: Technicians on a ladder repairing a second-floor window on a house with beige siding and a stone base.
A worker wearing a hard hat on scaffolding installing trim on the blue facade of a home.
A worker wearing green gloves removing damaged red and black shingles during a roof repair.
A professional wearing a hard hat and reflective vest adjusting roof shingles, demonstrating the use of safety equipment.
During the initial phase, the roof frame has aligned wooden beams secured with safety harnesses while the team checks leveling and temporary anchors before final sealing.
We apply Karnak asphalt primer and torch-weld a bituminous membrane, sealing joints and details around pipes and vents for long-lasting waterproofing.
We identified cracks, holes, and advanced rot in the original wood. We removed the damaged pieces, reinforced the beams with treated wood, and leveled the structure.
We installed 15 mm marine plywood panels secured with galvanized screws and neoprene washers for watertightness and durability. The result is a solid, even base ready for the next roofing phase.
Herramientas: Laser level: projects horizontal or vertical light lines for precise alignment.
Miter saw: an adjustable rotating blade that makes precise angled cuts in wood.
Pneumatic nail gun: drives nails with compressed air for fast fastening.
Concrete vibrator: vibrates fresh concrete to compact it and remove trapped air.
Stainless steel trowel: a hand tool for smoothing mortar and creating an even finish.
Caulking gun: pushes sealant from a cartridge to apply continuous, controlled beads.
